findings.title: check() docstring signature omits the method's explicit argument types
findings.description: RULE.DOC.SIGNATURE_MIRROR requires that 'an argument typed in the method is typed in the docstring.' The method defines verb::AbstractString and code::Integer, but the docstring's displayed signature line 14 shows the bare, untyped check(verb, code), so the docstring signature diverges from the actual method table on exactly the types the rule says must mirror.
findings.resolution_hint: Change the docstring's signature line to `check(verb::AbstractString, code::Integer)` so it mirrors the method's real type annotations.
